title: John J. Appleton to John Quincy Adams, Cadiz, 6 Aug 1823: 18 code groups in the JQA code (catalogue 637)

documents.shelfmark: NARA RG 59, Despatches from US Ministers to Spain vol. 22, M31 reel 24 (naId 188609418), frame 0134 left, foot (catalogue 637)

plaintext.source: Manning, Diplomatic Correspondence ... Latin-American Nations III (1925) doc. 1124 p. 2041 prints the 18 groups with '[no decodification]'.

transcription.notes: Contributed by WAINUT (27 Oct 2026). Read twice from the frame, the second time independently; agrees with Manning's printed groups. Measured with docs/_check_profile.py --measure --digits.

system.summary: John Quincy Adams's numerical syllable-and-word code of 1811-1812 (the = 1385), about 1,600 numbers, rebuilt in ../jqa; used here unchanged.
system.sibling_key: the JQA code, ../jqa/code_table.tsv (rebuilt there from the State Department clerk's decodes and Ford's printed decipherments of JQA's 1811-1812 despatches), applied unchanged
system.notes: distinct_symbols = distinct groups in appleton1823_transcription.txt (python docs/_check_profile.py --measure --digits). Marks: diamond after a group = plural; a raised double dot after 192, meaning unclear.

prior_solution.where: Manning, Diplomatic Correspondence ... Latin-American Nations III (1925) doc. 1124 p. 2041 prints the 18 groups with '[no decodification]'. One web search found no decipherment.

conditions.human_role: WAINUT set the task (catalogue 637) and the rules; the AI agents fetched the frames, transcribed, decoded, read and verified. No target-specific human intervention.
models: AI language-model agents (WAINUT); a vision-capable language model for the transcription

solution.what: WAINUT contribution: located catalogue 637 on NARA M31 reel 24 frame 0134 (Appleton, Cadiz, 6 Aug 1823), in the JQA code (the = 1385); a second coded leaf on frame 0150 found, not transcribed (bleed-through).
WAINUT contribution: 18 groups transcribed, read twice from the frame, the second time independently; all agree with Manning's printed groups.
WAINUT contribution: applied ../jqa/code_table.tsv unchanged: 16 of 18 groups valued, 14 give English directly ('... of [794] that La-fit-te was [192] and that he had a part in England').
WAINUT contribution: alphabetical-slot readings: 648 millions (also a clerk decode, ../jqa/code_conflicts.txt), 1088 seven [?], 794 dollars [?]; 192 open (hon-).
WAINUT contribution: wrong-key controls (decode.py --controls): function-word rate 0.50 for the true table, 0.00-0.17 for shifts of 1-100, 0.00-0.06 for random table permutations.
WAINUT contribution: Manning III doc. 1124 (p. 2041) prints the code undecoded; one web search found no decipherment.
WAINUT contribution: read in part (appleton1823_reading.md, read_share 0.8): 3 holes (seven?, dollars?, 192).

outcome.method_basis: The JQA code table (../jqa/code_table.tsv), rebuilt in targets/jqa for JQA's 1811-1812 St Petersburg despatches, applied unchanged; two values from the alphabetical slot, one group open.
outcome.fraction_read_source: appleton1823_reading.md: 12 of the 15 words of the cipher read (3 holes: seven?, dollars?, 192); read_share 0.8.

texts.label: Appleton to J. Q. Adams, Cadiz, 6 Aug 1823 (catalogue 637), M31 reel 24 frame 0134
texts.summary: The Spanish constitutional government's secret plan, told to the US charge by the finance minister Yandiola in the last weeks of the Cortes at Cadiz: liquidating an account in England would produce [?seven] millions of [?dollars]; Lafitte (probably the Paris banker Jacques Laffitte) was [192] and had a part in England.
texts.note: read_share counted on the 15 words of the cipher: 3 holes (seven?, dollars?, 192).

outcome.notes: Contributed by WAINUT (catalogue 637). Same code as ../jqa; nothing there is changed. Proposed table changes (not applied) are in NOTES.md.
